    Impact

    supervisor.summarise(10 years)

    I have spent ten years building software: enterprise apps at TCS, product architecture at Fidelity, and identity platforms for millions of customers at Walmart. For the last two years almost all of my work has been AI: agents that investigate incidents, skills that turn a demonstration into a repeatable playbook, a runtime that shrinks what goes into a model’s context, and the governance layer that decides what an agent may do on a user’s behalf. I contribute features upstream to Walmart’s internal AI super-agent, and I teach and write about it at Walmart-wide forums, on LinkedIn, and in essays on Medium about agents, retrieval and what happens behind a model’s answers.

    Writing the perfect prompt is often slower than doing the task. So mimo lets you show it instead: demo the workflow, talk through it, and the agent you already use turns that into a skill you can review and reuse.
